classification_contract.NATIVE_IR: Entrypoint authority is authenticated Koschei Object Space -> Native IR with no compatibility fallback.
classification_contract.COMPAT_MIGRATION_ONLY: Entrypoint still relies on compatibility Program/ModuleGraph/MIR or may select a compatibility backend; it is measurable migration debt and may not define new Koschei semantics.
classification_contract.FAIL_CLOSED_UNMIGRATED: Canonical native input is recognized but has no migrated handler; it must reject rather than fall back.
